element: YanceWorkspace.tsx remains a thin composition root that renders ProductExperienceShell.
The actual ProductExperienceShell remains identifiable as the Yance workspace and exposes an accessible Yance label.

RelationshipAssistant keeps post-mount Letta state observable using a cancellable refresh mechanism compatible with the Product reduced-motion contract; setInterval is not reintroduced.
Stale agent/conversation projections are cleared by the Product projection when Letta is unavailable, and bounded recent-conversation semantics remain explicit.
parlant: Goal CRUD remains contact-scoped through the existing guarded desktop API and no browser Goal persistence is introduced.
Background relationship events and refreshes must not overwrite an unsaved Goal draft or auto-select another relationship.
The test follows experienceProjection.ts, experienceSession.ts and RelationshipAssistant.tsx rather than requiring retired state variables inside YanceWorkspace.tsx.
media: Media remains visibly reachable from the Product relationship Action Dock and RelationshipOverlayHost.
MediaWorkspace remains the existing runtime-backed action authority; the Product shell does not create a second media or send runtime.
presence: Presence remains visibly reachable from the Product relationship Action Dock and RelationshipOverlayHost.
PresenceWorkspace and official livekit-client remain the realtime authority; the Product shell does not create custom WebRTC transport.
